skills.name: Servo Tuning
skills.subtitle: Movement bonus
skills.text: All of your mechs have +1 movement.

art.title: Servo bay
art.brief: A mechanic's wrench on the open knee joint of a Wisp; sparks printed in the amber plate.

skills.name: Final Push
skills.subtitle: 3 extra actions
skills.text: Once per turn you may take an additional action, then put a token on this card. If this card has three tokens on it, discard it.

art.title: Overheating
art.brief: A mech pushed past its limit: motor housing glowing, heat haze and sparks.

skills.name: Science Survey
skills.subtitle: Research bonus
skills.text: At the start of your turn, you may gain 2 Research.

art.title: Deep radar
art.brief: A radar station on the surface, its dish on the roof, its pulses going down through the strata.

skills.name: Paired Cannons
skills.subtitle: Combat with advantage
skills.text: For Combat rolls, roll twice and use the lower number.

art.title: Two barrels
art.brief: A Breacher front on, firing both arm cannons at the viewer, two muzzle flashes.

skills.name: Mech Pick
skills.subtitle: Controlled scrapping
skills.text: When a mech is placed in your salvage yard, choose its mech type.

art.title: Foreman
art.brief: A foreman with a clipboard in the salvage yard, pointing a crane at one chassis.

skills.name: Field Fitter
skills.subtitle: Flexible modification
skills.text: After refitting, you may increase or decrease the mech number by 1.

art.title: Gantry
art.brief: A Chameleon in a gantry with one arm off, the arm hanging from the hoist beside its open shoulder.

skills.name: Stand Down
skills.subtitle: Reduce power for research
skills.text: Once per turn, you may lose 1 Power and gain 3 Research.

art.title: Powered down
art.brief: A Chameleon powered down in a low crouch, venting heat.

skills.name: Second Charge
skills.subtitle: Extra mech ability
skills.text: Once per turn, you may use one mech ability a second time.

art.title: Override switch
art.brief: A hand flipping a guarded red switch on a cockpit panel.

skills.name: Prospectors
skills.subtitle: Bonus peaceful move
skills.text: At the end of your turn, if you did not Attack or Claim, gain an additional Move or Research action.

art.title: Sample drill
art.brief: A Wisp working a core drill on its tripod over cracked ice.

skills.name: Reactor Breach
skills.subtitle: Destroy your attacker
skills.text: When you defend, before players roll combat dice, you can decide to destroy both mechs (there is no power effect).

art.title: Strapped charge
art.brief: A Breacher with charges strapped across its chest.

skills.name: Crawlway
skills.subtitle: Slingshot past enemies
skills.text: You may move your mechs through enemy mechs. These spaces do not count towards your movement.

art.title: Between the legs
art.brief: A small mech ducking between two enemy mechs' legs.

skills.name: Armour Piercing
skills.subtitle: Combat bonus
skills.text: -1 to your Combat rolls.

art.title: Red barrel
art.brief: A Breacher's cannon barrel close up, heat shimmer printed as halftone.

skills.name: Field Refit
skills.subtitle: Adjust a mech
skills.text: Once per turn, you may increase or decrease one of your mech numbers by 1.

art.title: Repair arm
art.brief: A repair arm on its floor mount welding at a Tactician's hip joint.

skills.name: Breakthrough
skills.subtitle: Extra action for destruction
skills.text: The first time you destroy an enemy mech each turn, gain 1 action.

art.title: Stepping over
art.brief: A mech stepping over a smoking wreck, already turning to the next target.

skills.name: Drop Crew
skills.subtitle: Extra drop
skills.text: Gain an additional Drop action each turn.

art.title: Two pods
art.brief: Two drop pods coming down side by side, retro rockets in amber.

skills.name: Hacking
skills.subtitle: Flexible claiming
skills.text: When Claiming, you may add or subtract 1 from the objective number.

art.title: Spliced panel
art.brief: A hacker's hand terminal spliced into an objective's control panel, the 8 on its readout flickering to 7 and 9.

skills.name: Reserve Orders
skills.subtitle: Delayed tactics
skills.text: Whenever you take a Tactic, you may instead store it. At the end of each of your turns, you may play a stored Tactic. When you take this Skill, you may take and store a Tactic.

art.title: Lockbox
art.brief: A battered metal strongbox, its lid open a crack.

skills.name: First Survey
skills.subtitle: Claim with research
skills.text: You may use your Research number in place of one of your mech numbers when Claiming.

art.title: Flag and number
art.brief: A survey flag with a stencilled research number flying over an objective.

skills.name: Wreck Survey
skills.subtitle: Destruction is research
skills.text: The first time you destroy an enemy mech each turn, gain 3 Research.

art.title: Salvage drone
art.brief: A small drone hovering over a wreck, scanning it in amber lines.

skills.name: Rush Research
skills.subtitle: Accelerated breakthrough
skills.text: Your Research resets at 4, 5, or 6.

art.title: Running crew
art.brief: Two surveyors running back to camp with a sample case.

skills.name: Stolen Flag
skills.subtitle: Accelerated domination
skills.text: Your Power resets at 4, 5, or 6. When a player destroys one of your mechs, they may take this card from you.

art.title: Flag raised
art.brief: A victorious Chameleon holding up a flag over a downed mech.

skills.name: Arms Deal
skills.subtitle: Atomics from claiming
skills.text: When you take a card for Claiming, you may instead gain 1 Atomic.

art.title: Called in
art.brief: A strike beacon planted by a claim flag, the atomic it bought landing on the horizon.

skills.name: Drill Sergeant
skills.subtitle: Fixed combat
skills.text: Your Combat rolls are 3.

art.title: Drill ground
art.brief: Three Snipers lined up in step on a marked drill ground.

skills.name: Trophy Hunters
skills.subtitle: Power amplification
skills.text: The first time you destroy an enemy mech each turn, gain 1 additional Power.

art.title: Tally
art.brief: Stencilled kill marks on a mech's hull, a painter adding one more.

skills.name: Strip for Parts
skills.subtitle: Sacrifice for action
skills.text: Once per turn, you may destroy one of your mechs and gain 1 Action.

art.title: Crane
art.brief: A crane lifting a mech's reactor out of its chest.

skills.name: True Believers
skills.subtitle: Irreducible power
skills.text: You cannot lose Power. You cannot gain Research.

art.title: Slogan
art.brief: A wall stencilled NO RETREAT, its flag on the roof, a mech standing in front of it.

skills.name: Signal Jammer
skills.subtitle: Weaken your enemies
skills.text: The first time you destroy an enemy mech each turn, you may disable one of the enemy's Skills until the start of your next turn.

art.title: Jammer pod
art.brief: A jammer pod on a mech's shoulder, static rings in oxide.

skills.name: Double Time
skills.subtitle: Move more than once
skills.text: Your mechs can move or move/attack more than once per turn (each move counts as an action).

art.title: Column
art.brief: A column of mechs trudging through a dust storm, heads down.

skills.name: Drop Ships
skills.subtitle: Isolated drop
skills.text: You may drop to any space that is not adjacent to a mech.

art.title: Pod in the dust
art.brief: A drop pod falling into a dust storm, alone on the map.

skills.name: Close Protection
skills.subtitle: Combat support bonus
skills.text: During combat, if your mech is adjacent to one or more friendly mechs, -2 to your Combat roll.

art.title: Back to back
art.brief: Three mechs back to back, guns out in three directions.

skills.name: Entrenched
skills.subtitle: Strong defence
skills.text: When you are attacked, ties go in your favour and you destroy your attacker if you win (and gain power).

art.title: Trench
art.brief: A Breacher in a trench behind a barricade of boulders.

skills.name: Lunge
skills.subtitle: Bonus short move
skills.text: Once per turn, you may move/attack 1 space with a mech even if it's already moved.

art.title: Lunge
art.brief: A Breacher lunging forward one hex, its arm cannon level.

skills.name: Veteran Crew
skills.subtitle: Get more skills
skills.text: You can have up to 5 Skills.

art.title: Crew photo
art.brief: A crew photo, five people, each printed in a different ink.

skills.name: Martial Law
skills.subtitle: Claim with power
skills.text: You may use your Power number as an additional mech number when Claiming.

art.title: Loudspeaker
art.brief: A loudspeaker on a mast over a habitat, sound rings in oxide.

art.title: Poster
art.brief: A two-ink poster of raised fists and a mech standing on the red ground, no words.

art.title: Contraband
art.brief: Two atomic rockets in an open crate, warning stencils on them.

tactics.name: Headhunter
tactics.subtitle: Choose a skill
tactics.text: Search the Skill deck and take a card of your choosing, then shuffle the deck.

art.title: Crossing over
art.brief: A mech walking away from one side's flag to another's, where a Tactician waits for it.

tactics.name: Forced Advance
tactics.subtitle: Take a bonus turn
tactics.text: Immediately take another turn, but with 2 actions instead of 3 (treat it as a brand-new turn).

art.title: Dawn advance
art.brief: Mechs advancing at dawn, long shadows ahead of them.

tactics.name: Kill Zone
tactics.subtitle: Become the atomic
tactics.text: Until the end of your next turn, all your combat rolls are 1.

art.title: Crossfire
art.brief: An enemy mech caught in a marked kill zone, crossfire coming in from both sides.

tactics.name: Sabotage
tactics.subtitle: Limit enemy action
tactics.text: Every opponent's next turn has 2 fewer actions.

art.title: Grit
art.brief: A hand pouring regolith into an open gearbox.

tactics.name: Orbital Cannon
tactics.subtitle: Target destroyed
tactics.text: Destroy any one mech. Gain 1 Power.

art.title: Impact
art.brief: An enemy mech hit from above, an amber column of light.

tactics.name: Full Refit
tactics.subtitle: Destroy & reroll mechs
tactics.text: Destroy all your mechs. You may reroll any mechs in your salvage yard once. Drop any number of mechs.

art.title: Pods raining
art.brief: Drop pods coming down all over the map.

tactics.name: Ice Tunnel
tactics.subtitle: Teleportation system
tactics.text: Place the Ice Tunnel tokens on two different spaces on the board. Any player may consider those spaces adjacent.

art.title: Cross-section
art.brief: A cut-away of the ground: a tunnel joining two hexes underneath.

expansion.name: Reinforcements
expansion.subtitle: Expand your fleet
expansion.text: Immediately roll a reserve mech and put it in perimeter space on an objective with one of your cubes or in your salvage yard.

art.title: Rollout
art.brief: A new mech walking out of a dark workshop's doors.
